metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace exposing Danny's personal skill pack to Cowork and Claude Code.

plugins.name: danny-skills
plugins.description: Personal skill pack: dt-plan, dt-visualize-plan, dt-prototype, dt-review, dt-build (a plan -> visualize -> optional prototype -> critique -> build pipeline), dt-writing-draft and dt-writing-edit (sourced drafting and editing for letters, papers, and copy), dt-session-audit (autonomous end-of-session capture routing rules, facts, and terminology across CLAUDE.md / MEMORY.md / CONTEXT.md / glossary.md), dt-memory-hygiene (periodic memory bloat cleanup), and dt-handoff for single-use session continuity.
